title: Channels for a role that can’t publish
summary: Diceroll's Channels page for a member whose role reads Ship builds but can't publish or set up channels: everything stays in place and readable, the Publish button and every setup action are disabled, and one info callout names who can and how to ask.
compare: Publish 1.9.0 stays where it is, disabled (sunken fill, quiet edge), described by the callout; it is never hidden and never a dead end: the callout names Ana Lima and Jun Park and offers 'Ask for access' (admin-2-23).

The callout is info (lock glyph), said once at the top; no row repeats it. Setup buttons (Turn on, Continue, Add an MSIX build, Set up) are disabled the same way; Undo is left out: the callout already says setup is for Release managers.
The attention row keeps its fact (Google Play key expires Oct 16) and says who fixes it instead of a link this role can't use.
Reading is unchanged: the In use table, its links to each channel, statuses and copy buttons all work.
Ship builds is one identity: Release cyan rule and chip, crumb 'Diceroll › Ship builds' (B5).
Phone: the callout wraps under its glyph; disabled buttons keep their 24px targets.
